arg.name: map_yaml
arg.description: Path to the map YAML file

arg.name: obstacles_map_yaml
arg.description: Path to the obstacles map YAML file

arg.name: scan_topic_front
arg.description: The name of the output scan topic

arg.name: scan_topic_rear
arg.description: The name of the rear output scan topic

arg.name: params_file
arg.description: Path to the Nav2 parameters file

arg.name: controller_frequency
arg.description: Frequency of the controller in Hz

arg.name: path_align_forward_point_distance
arg.description: Forward point distance for PathAlign

arg.name: goal_align_forward_point_distance
arg.description: Forward point distance for GoalAlign

arg.name: inflation_radius
arg.description: Inflation radius for the costmap

arg.name: path_align_scale
arg.description: Scale for PathAlign

arg.name: goal_align_scale
arg.description: Scale for GoalAlign

arg.name: path_dist_scale
arg.description: Scale for PathDist

arg.name: goal_dist_scale
arg.description: Scale for GoalDist

arg.name: cost_scaling_factor
arg.description: Cost scaling factor for the inflation layer in the costmap

arg.name: base_obstacle_scale
arg.description: Base obstacle scale for the costmap. This is used by the local and global costmaps to scale the cost of obstacles.

arg.name: controller_plugin_type
arg.description: Type of controller plugin to use. Options: DWB, RPP, MPPI

arg.name: expected_planner_frequency
arg.description: Expected frequency of the planner in Hz

arg.name: planner_plugin_type
arg.description: Planner plugin to use for the navigation stack

arg.name: robot_radius
arg.description: Robot radius for the navigation stack. This is used by the local and global costmaps to scale the cost of obstacles.

arg.name: mppi_wide_cost_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the wide MPPI cost critic

arg.name: mppi_narrow_cost_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the narrow MPPI cost critic

arg.name: mppi_wide_path_align_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the wide MPPI path align critic

arg.name: mppi_narrow_path_align_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the narrow MPPI path align critic

arg.name: mppi_obstacles_critic_repulsion_weight
arg.description: Repulsion weight for the MPPI obstacles critic

arg.name: mppi_obstacles_critic_critical_weight
arg.description: Critical weight for the MPPI obstacles critic

arg.name: mppi_obstacles_critic_collision_margin_distance
arg.description: Collision margin distance for the MPPI obstacles critic

arg.name: mppi_wide_wz_std
arg.description: Standard deviation for the wide MPPI controller

arg.name: mppi_narrow_wz_std
arg.description: Standard deviation for the narrow MPPI controller

arg.name: velocity_smoother_feedback_type
arg.description: Feedback type for the velocity smoother. Options: CLOSED_LOOP, OPEN_LOOP

arg.name: dock_pose_stl_model_path
arg.description: Path to the STL model for the dock pose estimation

arg.name: battery_state
arg.description: Initial battery state passed to the simulator. 0=CHARGED, 1=GOOD, 2=UNKNOWN, 3=LOW_BATTERY

arg.name: use_battery_state_simulation
arg.description: Whether to use the battery state simulation node.

arg.name: publish_dock_point_cloud
arg.description: Whether to publish the dock point cloud for visualization.

arg.name: docking_bt_selection
arg.description: Short integer flag to indicate the BT to use for the docking procedure. If set to 0, the docking procedure with staging pose navigation is activated, if set to 1, the docking procedure without staging pose navigation is activated, if set to 2, the estimator-only docking procedure is activated.

arg.name: force_centroid_guess
arg.description: Whether to force the centroid guess in the docking procedure.

arg.name: use_statistical_outlier_removal_and_downsampling
arg.description: Whether to use statistical outlier removal and downsampling in the dock pose estimator.

arg.name: mppi_cost_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the general MPPI cost critic

arg.name: mppi_path_align_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the general MPPI path align critic

arg.name: mppi_time_steps
arg.description: Number of time steps (points) in candidate trajectories.

arg.name: mppi_batch_size
arg.description: Count of randomly sampled candidate trajectories from current optimal control sequence in a given iteration.

arg.name: mppi_vx_std
arg.description: Standard deviation for linear velocity in the MPPI controller.

arg.name: mppi_wz_std
arg.description: Standard deviation for the general MPPI controller

arg.name: mppi_vx_max
arg.description: Maximum linear velocity in the MPPI controller.

arg.name: mppi_temperature
arg.description: Selectiveness of trajectories by their costs.

arg.name: mppi_iteration_count
arg.description: Iteration count in the MPPI algorithm. Recommended to remain as 1 and instead prefer larger batch sizes.

arg.name: mppi_constraint_critic_cost_weight
arg.description: Cost weight for the MPPI constraint critic.

arg.name: staging_pose
arg.description: Staging pose of the robot in the map frame for docking. Format: 'x y Yaw'

arg.name: always_send_full_costmap
arg.description: Whether to always send the full costmap to the controller.

arg.name: transform_tolerance
arg.description: Transform tolerance for the navigation stack.

arg.name: use_patrol
arg.description: Launch the autonomous patrol node.

arg.name: patrol_waypoints_file
arg.description: Path to the patrol waypoints YAML file.
